task: drift-chamber waveform -> hit-count regression (streaming FPGA inference)

data.y_transform: PRO_Y (10-bit re_digi of predict500); for per-patch: 20-patch sums of is_primary3000[:,:500]

input.digitize: re_digi(x, vmin, vmax, bits)  -> integer ADC codes [0, 2^bw_inp)

output.note: kind=scalar (1/sample) or per_patch (N_PATCHES/sample). Output signedness + exact bit width come from the trained model's output quantizer (read off comb_full at convert time, NOT chosen here).

stream.note: II = length/patch_size. conv2_window>1 ONLY if a second conv with padding='same' mixes neighbor patches (=> 3-window shift buffer + per-patch einsum tail).

eval.note: Golden = da4ml comb_full.predict_raw (whole model, bit-exact to keras), sign-corrected. The RTL must reproduce it bit-exactly in no-pause AND backpressured modes.

targets.note: Set ebops to constrain FPGA cost (LUT/DSP) via BetaPID+ParetoFront; set perf_mae as the accuracy floor. null/null => plain unconstrained training.
